description.value: A Subway franchise located in the Nordel Shopping Centre in Delta, serving Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread. The location offers in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery. As a shopping centre tenant, it provides a convenient calories stop along the 84th Avenue corridor.
